issue.title: Reconcile Config Center populated PNG snapshot after selection restore
issue.description: The populated Config Center visual golden no longer matches the current rendered selection state.

fields.description: On current primary HEAD 661699f38, just test-visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_config_center_config.py::test_config_center_config_tab_png_snapshot -q fails deterministically: 14,495/1,520,532 pixels differ (0.953285%; 14,097 material). Visual inspection shows the expected image selecting the axe section summary while the actual image selects axe.chop_script_dirs and renders its field detail/provenance, consistent with recent Admin Center entry-selection behavior. Determine whether the selection is intentional, then update the golden or correct the initial selection; the earlier closed sase-bl covered prior baseline drift, not this current rendering.
